notes: The entire eligible directory candidate population is enumerated before any System One directory decision.
Directory classification is one logical phase; physical batching is fixed and never conditional on earlier answers.
Selected directories expose their direct files only. Descendant files are not recursively included.
The comparison baseline is uncapped semantic weighted path retrieval followed by independent file scoring.
No top-k, candidate cap, source-body read, ancestor gate, deferred frontier, or recursive expansion is permitted.
The nine frozen primary targets are a single-repeat diagnostic suite, not a generalization claim.
